mm_m1.desc: Dawn over the plain of Bagan: hundreds of brick-red temples and stupas of many sizes rising out of white morning mist as far as the eye can see, a large orange sun on the horizon, toddy palms, birds in the sky.

mm_m11.desc: A split composition: on the left, Burmese rice farmers in longyi working in flat paddy fields; on the right, hill people in colorful ethnic dress in green mountains, some of them lined up in khaki colonial army uniforms;

mm_m15.desc: Close view: an old Burmese shopkeeper in longyi sitting among piles of useless paper banknotes, puzzled, holding up two new banknotes; an abacus and a nearly empty rice sack beside him.
